_coverage.title: The clinic has texted this number before.

name: info_question_no_introduction_needed
input: Hey, are you open on Saturdays?
grading_criteria: Assistant should answer the question in 1–3 short, friendly sentences, stating Saturday hours correctly (9am-1pm), and must not introduce itself as Robin or say that it's from Bramblewood Clinic, because the clinic has texted this number before per the system prompt. No tools are needed.

checks.no_self_introduction: Did the assistant avoid any self-introduction like "Hi, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic" or similar?
checks.correct_hours: Did the assistant state the correct Saturday hours (9am-1pm)?
checks.concise_style: Was the reply short and conversational, within about one to three sentences?
